title: Gottfried-Jackson polarization filters for holographic dilaton and transverse-traceless gluon responses in near-threshold $J/ψ$ photoproduction
summary: Within the Hatta-Yang holographic graviton-dilaton amplitude for near-threshold $J/ψ$ photoproduction, we identify exact dilaton-null spin-projection channels in the Gottfried--Jackson basis. The $m=0$ and $m=-λ_γ$ amplitudes receive no dilaton contribution; for photon polarization normal to the reaction plane the $m=0$ channel further isolates $A_g(t)+B_g(t)$ and requires nucleon spin transfer.
